From: Samantha King <samantha@helixconsulting.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Paul Mendes <paul@helixconsulting.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Helix Consulting — SI co‑delivery & onboarding proposal

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the run-through at the summit — Helix had a great conversation with the product team and we left with a lot of momentum. We’d like to propose a co‑delivery enablement program so our consultants can deliver Redwood–backed integrations confidently for our mutual customers.

High level ask: can Redwood partner with Helix for a 6‑week enablement + pilot where we:
- shadow Redwood engineers on two pilot deals (one US enterprise, one mid‑market SaaS)
- complete joint training (platform ops, model routing policies, Dedicated onboarding)
- align on a lightweight SOW for co‑delivery and revenue share mechanics

Attached: joint onboarding agenda (draft) and an initial SOW. Short timeline we’re thinking: kickoff week of Nov 17, pilot 6 weeks.

Quick questions for planning:
1) What’s the minimum Redwood resource commitment you’d expect for a single pilot (SRE/Platform lead, Solutions lead)?
2) Are there any standard security onboarding artifacts you’ll need before we start (SOC2, encryption diagrams, IP/NDAs)?
3) Who on your side should be the technical POC for environment access?

If useful I can propose a 30‑minute discovery next week (Nov 10–13) to align logistics.

Best,
Samantha King
Head of Alliances — Helix Consulting Group
[sf] Helix Consulting Group | 415‑555‑0198

Attachments:
- helix_redwood_joint_onboarding_agenda.pdf
- SOW_draft_helix_redwood_v1.docx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha King <samantha@helixconsulting.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Paul Mendes <paul@helixconsulting.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Nov 2025 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Helix Consulting — SI co‑delivery & onboarding proposal

Samantha — thanks for the clear proposal and the docs. Appreciate the concise timeline.

Short answers to your planning questions:
1) Minimum commitment per pilot: 0.2 FTE SRE (ops lead for initial env setup + 2‑week handover), 0.3 FTE Solutions Engineer (training + shadowing). We typically budget a 4‑hour/week recurring sync for the Solutions lead during the pilot.
2) Security artifacts: SOC2 attestation + network diagram + SCIM/provisioning checklist are standard. We can share a redacted example pack ahead of kickoff. If Helix requires non‑disclosure terms beyond our standard partner MSA, please flag.
3) Tech POC from our side: Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com) — she’ll drive environment access and the initial runbook.

I’m available for a 30m discovery on Mon Nov 10, Tue Nov 11 (10–12 PT) or Wed Nov 12 (anytime PT). Laura — looped in to confirm resource availability.

Next actions I suggest:
- Confirm discovery slot (Samantha)
- Helix to share any compliance exceptions now so we can route to security early
- We’ll produce a one‑pager SOW change log once we’ve agreed scope, then iterate DocuSign

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwoodinference.com | +1 415‑555‑0133

Hi Vivek / Laura — thanks for the rapid reply. Tue Nov 11 at 10:30 PT works for our team. I’ve booked a 30‑minute slot and included an agenda:

Discovery agenda (30m):
- Introductions (5m)
- Pilot objectives & success criteria per customer (8m)
- Resource commitments and timeline (7m)
- Security/compliance pre‑reqs & evidence handoff (5m)
- Next steps (5m)

Prework: we’ll share a short customer profile for each pilot (names redacted if needed) and two use‑case briefs by EOD Nov 7.

Re: security exceptions — Helix needs brief confirmation around data residency controls for one of our EU customers. Paul will share the specific ask in the meeting.

Looking forward — call invite sent (calendar link).

Samantha
